results.title: Andersonville Theological Seminary
results.text: Andersonville Theological Seminary is a Christian seminary located in Camilla, Georgia. It was founded in 1981, and today has more than 7,000 enrolled students, and more than 30,000 graduates.

results.title: Bibliotheca Sacra
results.text: Bibliotheca Sacra is a theological journal published by Dallas Theological Seminary, first published in 1844 and the oldest theological journal in the United States. It was founded at Union Theological Seminary in 1843, and moved to Andover Theological Seminary (now Andover Newton Theological School) in 1844 after publishing three issues, to Oberlin College in 1884, and to Xenia Seminary in 1922. Dallas Theological Seminary (then the Evangelical Theological Seminary) took over publication in 1934.

results.title: United Lutheran Seminary
results.text: United Lutheran Seminary, located in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania and Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, will be one of the seven seminaries of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in America. The school was founded in 2017, as a consolidation between the Lutheran Theological Seminary at Gettysburg and the Lutheran Theological Seminary at Philadelphia. United Lutheran Seminary will continue under the charter of Lutheran Theological Seminary at Gettysburg. The new school will formally come into being on July 1, 2017.
